Vue 2.7.16 was paired with vue-demi 0.14.10 using its Vue 3 entry. Same pinia 2.3.1 compiled with two errors through installed entry, zero errors/warnings through bundled Vue 2.7 entry in isolated validation. Shared environment was not repaired and full Case 7 was not rerun.
